# Nail Care Market Segmentation

A split of the **nail** market into a price-sensitive *basic manicure* tier and
a defensible *enhancement* tier (structured gel, acrylics, nail art).

## The two tiers

- **Basic:** plain polish and manicures — most exposed to
  [[At-Home Nail Care Disruption]].
- **Enhancement:** technician-dependent work insulated from DIY substitution,
  including [[Gel Manicure Systems]].

Salons that competed on price for plain manicures are most exposed; those
selling enhancements and experience are insulated.
